document:0:455:0.text:
Found in the Serene Lyceum storeroom, this sketch was drawn nearly four centuries ago and remains in perfect condition thanks to magic.
The artist remains unknown, possibly one of the Serene Lyceum's students.
document:0:455:0.source_cn:
从莱希拉姆库房中发现的一幅简单绘画习作，经历近四世纪时光，却被魔法保护得完好如新。
作者不详，可能为莱希拉姆学生。

say:7:1610551504:0.text: He was a good man. So humorous and never harsh with any of the students. He spent more time guiding and encouraging us than he ever did scolding anyone.

say:8:1610551505:0.text: Only on rare occasions would he grow stern, and only when someone had made a serious mistake. He never favored me for my family's influence, nor pitied me for my condition.

say:9:1610551506:1.text: Of course, he did accept my parents' donations for the school and made his share of compromises... He wasn't flawless.
